problem_text:
A logistics firm must coordinate a specialized courier drone to perform a maintenance check at 11 distinct regional control towers.

The flight durations between towers, measured in minutes, are as follows:
* Tower Alpha to Bravo: 27.9 minutes
* Tower Alpha to Charlie: 101.9 minutes
* Alpha to Delta: 49.1 minutes
* Alpha to Echo: 62.4 minutes
* Alpha to Foxtrot: 127.0 minutes
* Alpha to Golf: 101.0 minutes
* Alpha to Hotel: 66.4 minutes
* Alpha to India: 99.6 minutes
* Alpha to Juliett: 95.2 minutes
* Alpha to Kilo: 105.8 minutes
* Bravo to Charlie: 74.6 minutes
* Bravo to Delta: 76.1 minutes
* Bravo to Echo: 89.1 minutes
* Bravo to Foxtrot: 103.5 minutes
* Bravo to Golf: 94.6 minutes
* Bravo to Hotel: 91.2 minutes
* Bravo to India: 116.3 minutes
* Bravo to Juliett: 90.8 minutes
* Bravo to Kilo: 91.2 minutes
* Charlie to Delta: 147.1 minutes
* Charlie to Echo: 163.7 minutes
* Charlie to Foxtrot: 44.3 minutes
* Charlie to Golf: 99.4 minutes
* Charlie to Hotel: 165.4 minutes
* Charlie to India: 165.2 minutes
* Charlie to Juliett: 102.0 minutes
* Charlie to Kilo: 107.1 minutes
* Delta to Echo: 38.1 minutes
* Delta to Foxtrot: 164.8 minutes
* Delta to Golf: 115.0 minutes
* Delta to Hotel: 50.8 minutes
* Delta to India: 71.2 minutes
* Delta to Juliett: 107.0 minutes
* Delta to Kilo: 149.0 minutes
* Echo to Foxtrot: 188.9 minutes
* Echo to Golf: 149.6 minutes
* Echo to Hotel: 13.9 minutes
* Echo to India: 107.6 minutes
* Echo to Juliett: 142.0 minutes
* Echo to Kilo: 138.6 minutes
* Foxtrot to Golf: 82.1 minutes
* Foxtrot to Hotel: 193.3 minutes
* Foxtrot to India: 163.8 minutes
* Foxtrot to Juliett: 88.0 minutes
* Foxtrot to Kilo: 151.3 minutes
* Golf to Hotel: 159.1 minutes
* Golf to India: 87.2 minutes
* Golf to Juliett: 8.5 minutes
* Golf to Kilo: 179.7 minutes
* Hotel to India: 121.1 minutes
* Hotel to Juliett: 151.9 minutes
* Hotel to Kilo: 131.0 minutes
* India to Juliett: 79.2 minutes
* India to Kilo: 205.0 minutes
* Juliett to Kilo: 177.8 minutes

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient inspection circuit, wherein the drone initiates its journey from a designated tower, visits every other tower precisely once, and ultimately returns to its point of origin.
